en: a as in father, short and open — авион (aeroplane)
b as in book — буба (bug)
v as in van — воз (train)
g as in go, always hard — грожђе (grapes)
d as in dog — дугме (button)
soft j, like the 'd y' in would you; the voiced partner of Ћ — ђон (sole of a shoe)
e as in bed, never a diphthong — ексер (nail)
zh, like the s in measure — жаба (frog)
z as in zoo — змај (dragon, kite)
ee as in see, short — игла (needle)
y as in yes, never the English j — јеж (hedgehog)
k as in key, no puff of air — крава (cow)
l as in leaf, light and clear — лабуд (swan)
ly, like the lli in million — љубичица (violet)
m as in mum — миш (mouse)
n as in nose — наочаре (glasses)
ny, like the ni in onion — њушка (snout)
o as in more, short and pure — око (eye)
p as in pen, no puff of air — потковица (horseshoe)
rolled r, tapped like the Spanish r; between consonants it becomes the vowel of the syllable, as in прст (finger) — рак (crab)
s as in sun, never a z sound — столица (chair)
t as in top, no puff of air — топ (cannon)
soft ch, like the 't y' in not yet, lighter than Ч — ћурка (turkey)
oo as in boot, short — уво (ear)
f as in fish — фока (seal)
h scraped at the back of the throat, like the ch in Scottish loch but much lighter — хлеб (bread)
ts as in cats, never a k sound — црв (worm)
hard ch as in church, tongue drawn back, heavier than Ћ — чекић (hammer)
hard j as in judge, the voiced pair of Ч — џеп (pocket)
sh as in shop — шапа (paw)
